decision.reason: 36Kr report describes 650 kg tethered, high-rise fire-fighting drone operating beyond ladder access; creates a verifiable human-managed site-acceptance evidence workflow (not autonomous firefighting guidance).

opportunities.idea_name: Tethered Fire Drone Field-Test Evidence Register
opportunities.core_job: Record authorized high-rise emergency response drone equipment trial evidence and human approval
opportunities.target_customer: Fire service drone program quality and procurement teams
opportunities.product_mechanism: Manual equipment identity, site access constraints, tether/water/power trial reports, authorized personnel, safety observer, failure records and acceptance signoff; no drone control or tactical directions
opportunities.why_now: 36Kr 13 October describes a 650kg ducted drone tethered to water and power to reach 100m facades when ladder trucks cannot reach; independent field acceptance is material.
opportunities.before_state: Pilot equipment claims and safety acceptance evidence isolated in vendor reports.
opportunities.after_state: Human-approved operational-readiness evidence case with explicit safety responsibility.
opportunities.source_verification: primary or original article web-read, downstream qualification pending
